snippet.title: Arrow (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
Move through the maze without hitting the walls. Collect points to grow your tail. Smash gems to unlock cool new arrow heads and backgrounds!

iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/arrow/id988476572

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.arrow
